# ferentin_data_protection_detector (Data Source)

Look up one built-in data-protection detector by ID (e.g. `US_SSN`). Referencing `.id` gives plan-time validation that the detector exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Singular — look one detector up by ID.
data "ferentin_data_protection_detector" "ssn" {
  id = "US_SSN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Detector ID, e.g. `US_SSN`.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `category` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `fpe_safe` (Boolean)
- `has_validator` (Boolean)
